target_claim: The generalized sum over J converges absolutely to r if and only if the series from n=1 of v_{j_n} converges absolutely to r, although the enumeration begins with j_0.
source_quote:
From [[Absolute Net Convergence Equivalent to Absolute Convergence]]: 
:the [[Definition:Generalized Sum|generalized sum]] $\ds \sum_{j \mathop \in J} v_j$ [[Definition:Absolute Net Convergence|converges absolutely]] to $r$ 
{{iff}}:
:the [[Definition:Series|series]] $\ds \sum_{n \mathop = 1}^\infty v_{j_n}$ [[Definition:Absolutely Convergent Series|converges absolutely]] to $r$
